suite: Notepad snapshot recovery and caret safety

checks.name: unsaved new text is a complete restorable snapshot
snapshot preserves Unicode and selected UTF-16 range
a new empty tab is a valid snapshot
dirty marker and localized app suffix do not split identical snapshots after source saving
working copy is automatically stored under app LocalAppData with exact text and resolved through host file virtualization
physical working copy explicitly stores a UTF-8 BOM
repeat resume never overwrites an earlier edited recovery copy
empty recovery copies decode to empty text
corrupt content fails before a recovery copy is written
Korean title matches the complete fresh recovery basename
English title matches the complete fresh recovery basename
filename-prefix collisions cannot authorize another editor
classic CRLF caret converts to a stable LF offset
stable LF offset converts back to a classic caret
RichEdit already counts a line break as one character
an impossible caret inside a CRLF pair fails closed
empty documents preserve the initial caret
reopen never clamps a caret after text becomes shorter
negative offsets cannot be restored
UTF-16 offset 0 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 1 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 2 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 3 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 4 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 5 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
UTF-16 offset 6 round trips across CRLF without losing surrogate units
native selection transport preserves start and end beyond 65,535
read-only selection transport does not change text or selection

limitation: Synthetic control and pure policy checks; installed Notepad capture and reopen are separate validation.
